materials: Poly Haven walnut_veneer (CC0), darkened + reddened derivative
Poly Haven oak_veneer_01 (CC0) for the oak build argument
mustKeep: three flush handle-less doors inside a slim frame with real reveals
two rectangular slab legs set in from the ends
veneer grain continuous across the three doors
avoid: facet shading on the big flat faces
legs poking outside the body outline
repeated identical grain on neighbouring parts

referenceImages.use: design-inspiration-only, never copied into repo or GLB

preflight.standsOn: floor, two slab legs (LEG_H 0.14) butting the body underside; one shared variable LEG_H for the contact chain.
preflight.mechanisms: Shell = rounded box r 4.5 cm on all edges with a boolean front pocket (2 cm deep, 6 cm end frame, 3 cm top frame). Doors = three separate prisms in the pocket, 3 mm reveals, 1 mm behind the frame face, 1 mm front-edge bevel; the solid pocket floor is the back panel so no light leaks. Push-to-open, no handles.
preflight.lightResponse: Satin veneer: roughness map from the scan, spec 0.42, normal 1.0, darker end grain on the legs; walnut albedo tinted [0.64,0.53,0.52] multiplied.
preflight.outline: Edge radius IS the outline (profile and side_low rendered). Legs stay inside the body footprint.

partTable.features: large-radius wrap, plain veneer, no handles
flush, handle-less, equal width (assumed), grain sequence-matched
rectangular slabs, vertical grain, straight (no splay)
closed: solid pocket floor, no modelled interior

inspiration.borrowed: low wrap-around console, three flush doors, slab legs, dark walnut
inspiration.changed: own proportions, own frame widths and pocket, own leg geometry, own veneer maps
